module: Source-bound standalone DxfOpaqueEntity retention with editable common metadata

fixture_factory.scope: Pinned initial declared-schema fixture factory only; all review assertions, mutations, metadata/placement carriers and output audits are independent.

coverage: Across six supported profiles and both input transports, exact complete source tags persist through both output transports and reload, including uninterpreted common/private groups, binary data and arbitrary nonsemantic handles.

Combined common appearance overlays preserve the original immutable SourceTags and exact private body. Checks cover actual layer identity, signed true-color encoding, lineweight, linetype scale, visibility, proxy bytes, available color-name/shadow fields and literal Unicode-looking XData strings.

CLASS source identity and semantic values are pinned. Replacing a declaration with an equal clone, changing fields, changing source profile or colliding with a writer-generated declaration rejects before stream/file mutation; correctly escaped literal CLASS text reloads unchanged.

Public aggregate/child/proxy names, excluded subclasses, public groups 66/101, duplicate common framing, malformed control groups, missing actual owner and extra unretained CLASS fields reject. Private groups containing lookalike codes remain inert in the positive source packet.

Actual source extension dictionary reciprocity and persistent reactors survive exact packet output. Reactor edits reject, source target removal remains blocked and restoring original metadata permits save.

Exact standard group 340 links to LAYER/LTYPE/STYLE/APPID block resource removal. Current common Layer/Linetype and XData APPID remain guarded, while old common resources release after explicit replacement. Source XData 1003 binds its actual layer, guards removal and emits its new name after rename.

Paper-space and unused-block placements retain their actual physical BLOCK_RECORD owner and complete packet. Block cloning and Insert explosion reject before handle mutation. Compatibility analysis includes these non-model source objects.

After mutable XData growth across 17 entities, the exact aggregate 1,048,576-tag boundary saves and reloads with every packet below 65,536 tags. One extra tag rejects in both transports before changing stream bytes/cursor, existing file bytes, source snapshots, registrations, CLASS identities or seed.

Binary comment output, embedded NUL and source profile changes reject before output/file replacement. Ordinary text and binary saves preserve source packet fields within the documented transport boundary.

findings.defect: Literal CLASS application text was reinterpreted on output because ordinary CLASS encoding did not escape literal backslashes. Loaded application text literal \U+0041 became literal A after save/reload.
findings.correction: df9b5ac selects backslash-safe encoding for declarations belonging to retained opaque entities and validates opaque string framing before output.

findings.defect: Source XData 1003 bound its actual Layer in References, but the shared table-resource collector omitted DxfOpaqueEntity, allowing Layers.Remove to remove that dependency.
findings.correction: 15b2281 adds DxfOpaqueEntity.References to the shared resource collector; direct Layer/Linetype/Style/APPID and current metadata controls pass.

scope: All unknown-entity fixtures are explicitly declared synthetic schemas built on ordinary netDxf scaffolds. No supplied native unknown entity producer packet was available; no application-private geometry or semantics are qualified.

ezdxf 1.4.4 retains QUALIFIED_FUTURE_CURVE as ezdxf.entities.dxfentity.DXFTagStorage. The 114 main output audits check surrounding DXF structure; they do not interpret the unknown entity or validate its application semantics. Exact raw/source packet assertions are separate.

No native CAD executable was available or invoked. Geometry, aggregate/embedded sequences, proxy entities, discarded external ACDSDATA, owner relocation, cloning and target-profile conversion retain explicit boundaries.

Two expanded-probe setup issues were corrected without source changes: a generated RASTERVARIABLES fixture initially kept a duplicate original CLASS, and legacy raw CLASS Unicode text now uses explicit wire Unicode escapes. A transient MSBuild ProcessName initializer failure was retried successfully.
